label: عبير — سعودية
ref_text: عند الانتهاء من مساعدتك، سيتم تحويل مكالمتكم لتقييم مدى رضاكم
source: tts-05172026/cloneVoice/abeer_ref_6s.wav (cut from 'Saudi Voice Artist Abeer Female Audio Sample.wav')
notes: Abeer, a Saudi female voice artist: a real recording, cut from her demo sample, which no model here trained on (the clone_abeer voice of the Saudi benchmark). Cloned with the omnivoice_najdi model the speech stays Saudi (P(Gulf) 0.99) and scores the highest UTMOS of the built-in voices (3.70), while the timbre moves toward the model's own voices (similarity to her sample 0.62; the stock model reaches 0.75).
